# Upstream license sources

For crates that omit license text from their published archive, the notices in this directory were obtained from the upstream revision recorded in the crate's `.cargo_vcs_info.json`, or its corresponding official release tag when that revision is unavailable. Font notices bundled by `epaint_default_fonts` are retained in its `fonts` directory.
